content.description:
Founded by the member of the BAYC community, known as Blue Magic, BAYC Ape #4064, the Boss Cat Rocket Club is a finite supply of 9,999 algorithmically generated space bound cats living on the Cardano Blockchain.

With massively inflated gas fees now on Ethereum, the decision was made to launch on the emerging Cardano Blockchain where we believe our project will be far more accessible to everyone. Since then, BCRC has released its own metaverse Boss Planet, which will launch in 2023 Q4.
